scientific_integrity: A direct bijection gives a parsimonious transfer of the published subcubic Widom–Rowlinson counting problem. The full corona polynomial is prior and credited. Finite checks corroborate the bijection's count identity, not the hardness theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple one-leaf coronas. The counting result uses the published fixed-target homomorphism theorem, and is not a claim of new polynomial coefficients. Kaidash (2024) was not available in full.
title: Counting super dominating sets of leaf coronas is #P-complete
